annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于印发《政府采购领域“整顿市场秩序、建设法规体系、促进产业发展”三年行动方案（2024—2026年）》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan (2024–2026) for Government Procurement: Rectifying Market Order, Building a Legal System, Promoting Industrial Development
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
annotation.venue: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府网站
annotation.summary_en: General Office of the State Council notice issuing a 2024–2026 three-year action plan on government procurement: cracking down on violations, building the legal and standards system, and using procurement to support innovation, SMEs and green products. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Special campaigns against discriminatory clauses, agency overcharging, false materials and bid rigging
Amend the Government Procurement Law and align it with the Bidding Law, GPA and CPTPP
Establish domestic-product and procurement demand standards, including green procurement
Support innovation via mandatory/priority purchasing and first-purchase orders
Extend SME set-aside of 40%+ for large projects to end-2026
